items.title: Rust 1.100 Introduces Cargo Security Cooldowns to Prevent Malicious Dependency Attacks
items.description: Rust 1.100 will introduce optional security cooldowns in Cargo, giving developers a way to delay newly published dependencies before they enter projects. Scheduled for November 12, 2026, the release aims to give security teams and package maintainers time to spot malicious updates before automated builds pull them in. items.description: TeamUpdraft, the developer behind the UpdraftPlus WordPress backup plugin, has disclosed a website breach that exposed remote management keys. items.title: PHP2Shell: Two Unpatched Critical PHP RCE Flaws (CVSS 9.2) Trigger Emergency Security Alert
items.description: PHP will ship an out-of-cycle security release at 14:00 UTC today, October 21, for two critical vulnerabilities that its security team has rated 9.2 on the CVSS v4.0 scale but has not described. Security researchers at watchTowr say the two flaws allow remote code execution. Only the four supported PHP branches, 8.2 through 8.5, can receive the fix, and no exploitation has been reported so far.
